name: Price Center food court
activity: At the food court, each person nominates one snack. Compare picks and choose a first stop together.

name: Convoy Street (KBBQ, ramen, boba)
activity: Before ordering on Convoy Street, everyone recommends one food they would like the group to try.

name: Boba spot near campus
activity: While waiting for drinks, build a shared playlist with one song and a short story from each person.

name: La Jolla village bookshop + coffee
activity: Browse for five minutes, then each share a book cover that made you curious.

name: La Jolla Shores beach
activity: Take a short beach walk. Each person picks one thing to stop and notice along the way.

name: Torrey Pines Gliderport cliffs
activity: At the viewpoint, each share one place you would like to explore and what draws you there.

name: Torrey Pines trails
activity: Choose a short trail together and take turns pointing out something you notice along the way.

name: La Jolla Cove (sea lions + tacos)
activity: From a respectful distance, spot wildlife and compare the animal facts each person knows.

name: Westfield UTC
activity: Take a window-shopping walk. Each person points out one design they would borrow for a fictional shop.

name: Movie theater at UTC
activity: Compare the movie posters outside the theater and each pitch which film the group should see another day.

name: Campus game lounge
activity: Choose an available game, teach one rule each, and reshuffle teams after a short round.

name: Board game cafe, Kearny Mesa
activity: Choose a short game together. Everyone teaches or asks about one rule before the first round.

name: RIMAC courts and field
activity: Bring a ball, agree on simple rules, and play a short pickup round with reshuffled teams.

name: Birch Aquarium
activity: Before deciding whether to enter, each nominate one sea creature you would like to learn about.

name: Balboa Park museums
activity: Walk through the park and each point out one detail you would sketch or photograph.

name: Pacific Beach boardwalk
activity: Take a boardwalk stroll and trade one song recommendation each for a shared playlist.
